lines.zh: 暖水里游着舒服，鳍都松了。
lines.en: The warm water loosens my fins nicely.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚走，别碰那些枝。
lines.en: I keep close to the coral, avoiding the branches.

lines.zh: 背上的刺竖着，路就宽了。
lines.en: My spines stand up, and the way clears.
The water is shallow here; light reaches the floor.
One swing of my tail leaves a faint mark in the sand.
I circle the reef, taking my time.
The tide pushes me, so I go with it.
The warm current comes from the south; I follow.
Don't come close; a spine will snag you.
I slip between the water grasses.
I know those stones on the bottom.
This water is gentler than the deep sea.
I swim low, hugging the sand.

lines.zh: 走这一圈，刺又硬了一点。
lines.en: Round this lap, my spines hardened a little.

lines.zh: 我把刺收低一点，才好转弯。
lines.en: I lower my spines a little so I can turn.

lines.zh: 一道光斜下来，我跟着游过去。
lines.en: A shaft of light slants down; I follow it.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，刺慢慢张开。
lines.en: I hang in the water and slowly spread my spines.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过水面，落在背上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the surface onto my back.
A little fish circles between my spines.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像块礁石。
lines.en: When I'm still, I look like a rock.

lines.zh: 暖水泡着我的鳃，很舒服。
lines.en: Warm water bathes my gills; it feels good.

lines.zh: 我把一根断刺重新磨尖。
lines.en: I grind a broken spine sharp again.

lines.zh: 珊瑚在响，是细小的爆裂声。
lines.en: The coral crackles with tiny popping sounds.

lines.zh: 我数着水面上晃的光斑。
lines.en: I count the light patches wobbling on the surface.

lines.zh: 潮退了一点，礁石露出来了。
lines.en: The tide fell a little; the reef shows.
Something rubs against my spines — itchy.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转了个身，刺朝外。
lines.en: I turn slowly, spines facing outward.
I'm used to this warm water.

lines.zh: 退潮时，我往深处挪一点。
lines.en: At low tide I shift a bit deeper.
One spine is loose; it must grow back.
On land you're safe from me.

lines.zh: 你下水了，那就不一样了。
lines.en: You've entered the water — that changes things.
A bucket at your waist — planning to scoop me up?
I see you don't swim very steadily.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡得住刺，挡不住炸。
lines.en: Your armor stops spines, not the blast.
You stepped on coral; move back.
You smell of sea urchin.
Don't come from above; that's the perfect angle.
I'm watching you, and you haven't noticed.
A net in your hand? Useless.
Two spines broke; they'll grow back.
Don't hit my belly; it's soft there.
That blow muddied the water.

lines.zh: 我的刺被压弯了，得掰回来。
lines.en: A spine is bent; I'll have to straighten it.

lines.zh: 你打中刺根了，最疼就是那儿。
lines.en: You hit the base of a spine — that's the sorest spot.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我往礁缝里缩。
lines.en: After that hit, I shrink into the reef crevice.
Blood trails away in the water.
That one earned a grudge.
It hurts, but I won't go ashore over it.

lines.zh: 这一下不轻，你藏了力气。
lines.en: That was no light blow; you've been holding back.
What's that? Smells like sea urchin.
Set it on the surface; I'll come up.

lines.zh: 会动的东西，才值得我抬眼。
lines.en: Only moving things are worth lifting my eyes for.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进来了，胆子不小。
lines.en: You put your hand in — brave.
A little closer — within spine's reach.

lines.zh: 别拿食物晃，我不吃这个。
lines.en: Don't wave food; I don't eat that.

lines.zh: 我要的是你下水，不是这些。
lines.en: I want you in the water, not this.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and I'll forget it.

lines.zh: 那东西在水里沉得很慢。
lines.en: That thing sinks very slowly in the water.
I circle it once and take a look first.

lines.zh: 小心我的刺，划破不负责。
lines.en: Mind my spines; I won't answer for cuts.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，刺扎进你袖子里了。
lines.en: You bumped me; a spine went into your sleeve.
Make way; this hide is not to be touched.
This coral patch is my spot.
You kicked me; the water went cloudy.

lines.zh: 我这身体硬，撞着像撞石头。
lines.en: This body is hard, like hitting stone.
Don't crowd; our spines will lock.
Back off; my spines are still out.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我让半步就是了。
lines.en: One bump and I'll yield half a step.

lines.zh: 水下看不清，你不是故意的。
lines.en: You can't see well down here; it was an accident.

lines.zh: 你的刺比我长，颜色也深。
lines.en: Your spines are longer, and darker.
Come closer, but don't point your spines at me.

lines.zh: 两颗带刺的，挤在一起不容易。
lines.en: Two spiny things fitting together isn't easy.
Come to that warm water with me — more reef.
We only fight in the water, both of us.
Have you been caught in a net too?
Turn slowly; let our spines pass each other.
This reef crevice holds two.
The tide will keep the door for us.
No rush; swim side by side a while first.
I can hold this bone in my mouth.
What falls belongs to the seabed.

lines.zh: 我把它压在两块石之间。
lines.en: I wedge it between two stones.
This sea urchin shell is still whole.
I'm not picky about what sinks.
I swim a circle around it first.
Hold it; don't let the tide take it.

lines.zh: 这是我的，水底也有规矩。
lines.en: It's mine; the seabed has rules too.

lines.zh: 我把它推到礁缝里藏好。
lines.en: I push it into the reef crevice for safekeeping.

lines.zh: 多一块，窝里就多一分硬。
lines.en: One more piece makes my nook a bit sturdier.
Someone entered the water; the ripples changed.

lines.zh: 那双腿在踩水，位置不高。
lines.en: Those legs are treading water, not deep.
The spines on my back begin to tighten.
A shadow presses down from the surface.

lines.zh: 你入了我的水，就得按我的规矩。
lines.en: You've entered my water; my rules apply.
I rise a little to get a clear view.

lines.zh: 那股味道是从气泡里来的。
lines.en: That scent comes from the bubbles.

lines.zh: 我认得这张网，上次也是它。
lines.en: I know that net; it got me last time.
Behind the reef, I wait for you to pass.
The target is in the water — that's enough.

lines.zh: 我竖起的刺都朝你那侧。
lines.en: My raised spines all lean your way.
Don't go ashore; I won't follow out of the water.
Close enough now; I'm counting it.
You're in the shallows; few ways back.
I drift slowly to your flank.
The water hides me; you can't see.
The tips of my spines are warming.

lines.zh: 你每划一下水，都慢半分。
lines.en: Every stroke you take is half a beat slower.
I'll wait until your air runs out.
Any closer and I'll stop being polite.

lines.zh: 一排刺射出去，扎在礁上。
lines.en: A row of spines flies and sticks in the reef.
That spine explodes where it lands.
I don't close in; I sting from afar.

lines.zh: 水里炸开一圈白，看不清了吧。
lines.en: A white ring bursts in the water — blinded yet?
The spine went into a gap in your armor.

lines.zh: 这一根是直的，下一根会拐。
lines.en: This one flew straight; the next will curve.
You dodged, but the shockwave remains.

lines.zh: 我一次只射三根，够用了。
lines.en: I fire three at a time — enough.
Don't fight me in the water.
Retreat to land and I'll stop.

lines.zh: 暖水里，我第一下就竖起了刺。
lines.en: In warm water, my first act was to raise my spines.

lines.zh: 我落在珊瑚旁边，颜色正好。
lines.en: I settle by the coral, and the color fits.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推上浅滩，又退回去。
lines.en: The tide pushed me onto the shallows, then back.

lines.zh: 这片海水是温的，我喜欢。
lines.en: This seawater is warm; I like it.

lines.zh: 我在礁缝里醒来，周围很挤。
lines.en: I wake in a reef crevice, pressed tight.
The spines rise one by one, slowly.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我眯眼。
lines.en: The light on the surface makes me squint.
No predators here — for now.

lines.zh: 我试着射了一根刺，很准。
lines.en: I test-fired one spine; it flew true.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片礁归我巡。
lines.en: From today I patrol this reef.
The water burns? My spines have curled.
Hitting the reef snapped half my spines.

lines.zh: 我在水里，你担心错对象了。
lines.en: I'm in the water; you're worried about the wrong one.
The water the blast threw up hurts more than spines.
That arrow went through my fin.

lines.zh: 有股力量把我的刺往里压。
lines.en: Some force is bending my spines inward.
Hunger is fine; I don't eat often.

lines.zh: 雷进了水，整片海都在麻。
lines.en: Lightning entered the water; the whole sea went numb.

lines.zh: 这里一滴水都没有，我撑不久。
lines.en: Not a drop of water here; I won't last.
